speaker: 旁白
text: 十一点的医院走廊，只有护士站还亮着成排的灯。坂口从病房巡视回来，推开休息室的门。
en: At eleven at night, only the rows of lights at the nurses' station still illuminated the hospital corridor. Returning from his ward rounds, Sakaguchi pushed open the lounge door.

speaker: 旁白
text: 御園芹香坐在窗边，正看着桌上一杯冷掉的咖啡。她听见开门声，才抬起眼。
en: Serika Misono sat by the window, looking at a cup of cold coffee on the table. Only when she heard the door open did she raise her eyes.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生？这么晚还在？」
en: “Dr. Misono? You're still here this late?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……坂口医生。」
en: “…Dr. Sakaguchi.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「今晚你也值班？」
en: “Are you on duty tonight too?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香摇摇头。
en: Serika shook her head.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「不是。影像科的工作已经做完了。」
en: “No. I've finished my work in radiology.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「那怎么还不回家？」
en: “Then why haven't you gone home?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……回去也没有什么事。」
en: “…There's nothing to do there anyway.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她把纸杯转了半圈，停下。
en: She turned her paper cup halfway around, then stopped.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「这里至少还有人。多待一阵子，也没什么不好。」
en: “At least there are people here. There's nothing wrong with staying a little longer.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「把医院当成消磨时间的地方？你以前可不像会说这种话的人。」
en: “Using the hospital to pass the time? That doesn't sound like the person you used to be.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你以前也不像会陪别人逛一下午乐器店的人。」
en: “You didn't seem like someone who would spend an entire afternoon visiting music shops with someone either.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「……这件事还要提多久？」
en: “…How long are you going to keep bringing that up?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「直到你能听出贝斯为止。」
en: “Until you can pick out the bass.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她嘴角轻轻动了一下，很快又看向窗外。
en: The corners of her mouth moved slightly before she turned back to the window.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「咖啡都凉了。我再给你倒一杯？」
en: “Your coffee's cold. Shall I get you another?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「不用。你不是在值班吗？」
en: “No need. Aren't you on duty?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「值班医生也有喝咖啡的自由。」
en: “Even the doctor on duty is allowed to drink coffee.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……那我要热的。」
en: “…Then I'd like mine hot.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口走向热水壶。才拿起一个纸杯，口袋里的呼叫终端忽然亮了起来。
en: Sakaguchi walked toward the kettle. He had just picked up a paper cup when the pager in his pocket suddenly lit up.

speaker: 旁白
text: 屏幕上的文字只有两行：急诊接诊。女性，严重出血，意识不清。请外科立即到场。
en: The screen showed only two lines: Emergency admission. Female, severe bleeding, impaired consciousness. Surgery team, attend immediately.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「抱歉，咖啡得欠你了。」
en: “Sorry. I'll owe you that coffee.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「急诊？」
en: “An emergency?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「大量出血。我得下去看看。」
en: “Heavy bleeding. I need to go down and have a look.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口已经转身。身后传来椅子轻轻向后挪动的声音。
en: Sakaguchi had already turned away. Behind him came the soft scrape of a chair sliding back.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「坂口医生。」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “Yes?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我也去。」
en: “I'm coming too.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你不是下班了？」
en: “Aren't you off duty?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「影像科的工作做完了，不代表我现在不能帮忙。」
en: “Finishing my work in radiology doesn't mean I can't help now.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她拿起白大褂口袋里的笔，重新扣好衣襟，已经走到门口。
en: She picked up the pen from her white coat pocket, fastened her coat again, and was already at the door.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。先去看看病人。」
en: “All right. Let's see the patient first.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 两人一前一后走向电梯。休息室里新拿出的空纸杯，还留在热水壶旁边。
en: They headed for the elevator, one behind the other. The empty paper cup he had just taken out remained beside the kettle in the lounge.

speaker: 旁白
text: 急诊室的门大开着。两名护士正把担架车推进抢救位。
en: The emergency room doors stood wide open. Two nurses were wheeling a stretcher into the resuscitation bay.

speaker: 利根川安琪
text: 「成年女性。路人从郊外空地发现的，救护车送来时已经没有反应。没有找到身份证件。」
en: “An adult woman. A passerby found her in an open area outside town. She was already unresponsive when the ambulance arrived. No identification was found.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 患者身上盖着厚毯，脸色苍白，头发贴在额头上。病床一侧的敷料已经被血浸透，护士仍在持续压迫止血。
en: The patient lay beneath a thick blanket, her face pale and her hair plastered to her forehead. The dressing at one side of the bed was soaked through with blood, and a nurse was still applying pressure to control the bleeding.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「血压？」
en: “Blood pressure?”

speaker: 利根川安琪
text: 「七十八／四十六，心率一百三十二。已经建立两条静脉通路，备血申请送出去了。」
en: “Seventy-eight over forty-six, heart rate one hundred thirty-two. Two IV lines are in place. The blood request has been sent.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「通知血库，准备输血。继续补液，监测意识。先把体温保住。」
en: “Notify the blood bank and prepare to transfuse. Continue fluids and monitor her consciousness. Keep her warm.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 护士为患者换上干净保暖毯。监测屏上的数字仍然不稳定。
en: A nurse replaced the patient's blanket with a clean, warm one. The numbers on the monitor remained unstable.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「她是在哪里被发现的？」
en: “Where was she found?”

speaker: 利根川安琪
text: 「路边草地。发现她的人说，当时她身上没有衣服，也没有随身物品。」
en: “In grass beside the road. The person who found her said she had no clothes or belongings.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香没有接话。坂口俯身确认呼吸、瞳孔及腹部体征，又查看已经采取临时止血措施的伤处。
en: Serika said nothing. Sakaguchi leaned over to assess the patient's breathing, pupils, and abdominal signs, then examined the injury where temporary bleeding control was already in place.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「下身出血量太大。先排除腹腔和盆腔深部损伤。」
en: “There's too much bleeding from below. We need to rule out deep abdominal and pelvic injuries first.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我来做床旁超声。」
en: “I'll do a bedside ultrasound.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。注意不要耽误抢救。」
en: “Good. Don't let it delay resuscitation.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香把超声探头贴在患者腹部。屏幕的灰白影像随着探头位置而变化。
en: Serika placed the ultrasound probe against the patient's abdomen. The gray-white image on the screen shifted with the probe.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「盆腔有异常液体积聚。右侧组织轮廓也不清楚……可能不只是表面裂伤。」
en: “There's an abnormal collection of fluid in the pelvis. The tissue contours on the right are unclear too… This may be more than a superficial laceration.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「外伤造成的？」
en: “Traumatic injury?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「现在只能说高度怀疑。她的循环状态不允许慢慢等完整检查。」
en: “All I can say now is that it's highly suspicious. Her circulation won't let us wait for a full workup.”

speaker: 利根川安琪
text: 「血到了。」
en: “The blood is here.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口向护士交代输血与连续监测，重新检查伤处的出血情况。
en: Sakaguchi gave the nurse instructions for transfusion and continuous monitoring, then reassessed the bleeding at the injury.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「目前的压迫只能暂时减少出血。必须把深部出血点找出来。」
en: “Pressure is only reducing the bleeding temporarily. We have to locate the deep source.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香将探头放回托架，正准备报告其他影像所见。她忽然停住。
en: Serika returned the probe to its holder and was about to report her other findings. Suddenly, she stopped.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Wait.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她向床头走近一步，视线落在患者的侧脸上。
en: She took a step toward the head of the bed, her eyes settling on the patient's profile.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…It can't be.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生？」
en: “Dr. Misono?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香的手仍停在半空。她的脸色比刚才更白了。
en: Serika's hand remained suspended in midair. Her face had grown paler.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Nanami?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 患者没有回应。只有监测仪上的心率数字不停跳动。
en: The patient did not respond. Only the heart-rate numbers on the monitor kept changing.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你认识她？」
en: “You know her?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「堀内……堀内奈奈美。」
en: “Horiuchi… Nanami Horiuchi.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「朋友？」
en: “A friend?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香张了张口，过了片刻才发出声音。
en: Serika parted her lips. A moment passed before any sound came out.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「以前的同事。在之前的医院……」
en: “A former colleague. At my previous hospital…”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我主刀的时候，她是我的器械护士。」
en: “She was my scrub nurse when I operated.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她看着奈奈美，眼神像被牢牢钉在同一个地方。
en: She stared at Nanami, her gaze fixed rigidly in place.

speaker: 利根川安琪
text: 「医生，血压还是上不来。」
en: “Doctor, her blood pressure still isn't coming up.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生，看着我。」
en: “Dr. Misono, look at me.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香终于抬头。
en: At last, Serika looked up.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「她现在是我们的病人。你先去旁边坐一下，接下来我来处理。」
en: “She's our patient now. Go and sit down for a moment. I'll take over from here.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「不用勉强。你知道她是谁，受到冲击很正常。」
en: “You don't have to push yourself. You know who she is. It's natural to be shaken.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香低下头，用力握了一下自己的双手。
en: Serika lowered her head and clasped her hands tightly together.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……给我一分钟。」
en: “…Give me one minute.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她走到洗手池旁，以冷水冲洗手指，抬头看了眼镜子。片刻后，她回到坂口面前。
en: She walked to the sink, rinsed her fingers with cold water, and looked up at the mirror. A moment later, she returned to Sakaguchi.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我能继续工作。」
en: “I can keep working.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你确定？」
en: “Are you sure?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我知道自己现在是什么状态。如果你认为我不合适，我会退出。」
en: “I know what state I'm in. If you think I'm unfit, I'll step aside.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「但如果还需要助手……请让我留下。」
en: “But if you still need an assistant… please let me stay.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口看着她。芹香这次没有避开他的视线。
en: Sakaguchi looked at her. This time, Serika did not look away.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。不过你的状态由我判断。必要时我会让你换下来。」
en: “All right. But I'll judge how you're doing. If necessary, I'll have you step away.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「明白。」
en: “Understood.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口转向护理台。
en: Sakaguchi turned toward the nursing desk.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「安琪，通知手术室准备急诊开腹探查。需要两名器械护士、两名巡回护士，监护由巡回负责。我和御園医生先去准备。」
en: “Ange, notify the OR to prepare for an emergency exploratory laparotomy. We need two scrub nurses and two circulating nurses; the circulating nurses will handle monitoring. Dr. Misono and I will go and prepare.”

speaker: 利根川安琪
text: 「收到。我联系手术室，继续看着输血，等他们来接病人。」
en: “Understood. I'll contact the OR, keep watch over the transfusion, and wait for them to collect the patient.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香重新看向奈奈美，伸手替她把滑下的毯角盖好。
en: Serika looked back at Nanami and reached out to tuck the slipped corner of the blanket back over her.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……奈奈美。再坚持一下。」
en: “…Nanami. Hold on a little longer.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美被推上手术台。折川皐月站在巡回监护位确认心电与血压设备，米田栞在一旁核对输血通路；薗田愛実和岩崎留美穿好无菌手术袍，准备器械台。
en: Nanami was transferred onto the operating table. Satsuki Orikawa checked the ECG and blood-pressure equipment at the circulating nurse's monitoring position, while Shiori Yoneda verified the transfusion line nearby. Itsumi Sonoda and Rumi Iwasaki donned sterile gowns and prepared the instrument table.

speaker: 折川皐月
text: 「麻醉准备和气道保护已经完成。循环很不稳定，输血还在继续。我负责监护，任何变化都会立刻报告。」
en: “Anesthesia preparation and airway protection are complete. Her circulation is very unstable, and the transfusion is continuing. I'll handle monitoring and report any change immediately.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。你负责循环，我尽快控制出血。」
en: “Good. You manage her circulation. I'll control the bleeding as quickly as possible.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香在术前参与确认深部伤口和影像所见，随后重新走到坂口身旁。她已经把自己观察到的损伤范围记在了脑中。
en: After helping confirm the deep injuries and imaging findings before surgery, Serika returned to Sakaguchi's side. She had committed the extent of the damage she had seen to memory.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「损伤在深部。形态像是外来硬物造成的穿透伤，不是普通的黏膜裂口，宫颈侧方也受到了牵连。具体经过得等她醒来才知道。」
en: “The damage is deep. Its shape suggests penetration by a hard foreign object, not an ordinary mucosal tear. It also involves the side of the cervix. We'll have to wait until she wakes to learn what happened.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「血止不住。腹腔内又有积血，我准备开腹找出血源。」
en: “The bleeding won't stop, and there's blood in the abdomen. I'll open her abdomen to find the source.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我来协助辨认子宫和周围的损伤。必要时按你的指示调整术野。」
en: “I'll help identify the injuries to the uterus and surrounding structures, and adjust the field as you direct.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香已经刷好手，等在手术室无菌区域外。负责第二巡回的米田栞协助她穿上无菌手术袍，系紧背后的带子。
en: Serika had scrubbed and was waiting outside the sterile area. Shiori Yoneda, the second circulating nurse, helped her into a sterile gown and tied the straps behind her.

speaker: 旁白
text: 她把双手伸入无菌手套。第一只手套戴到一半时，指尖短短停住。
en: She slipped her hands into sterile gloves. Halfway into the first glove, her fingertips paused briefly.

speaker: 薗田愛実
text: 「御園医生？」
en: “Dr. Misono?”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…I'm fine.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她把手套拉好，走到手术台旁。隔着铺好的无菌巾，她看不见奈奈美的脸。
en: She pulled the glove into place and approached the operating table. Beyond the sterile drapes, Nanami's face was out of sight.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生。准备好了吗？」
en: “Dr. Misono. Ready?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「准备好了。」
en: “Ready.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 手术团队核对患者临时身份、抢救指征、拟行术式、用血准备与各人职责，确认无误。
en: The surgical team verified the patient's temporary identity, emergency indications, planned procedure, blood supply, and everyone's responsibilities, confirming that all was correct.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「开始。」
en: “Let's begin.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 下腹部切口建立后，坂口逐层进入腹腔。吸引器清走积血，盆腔深部的情况逐渐显露出来。
en: After making the lower abdominal incision, Sakaguchi entered the abdomen layer by layer. Suction removed the pooled blood, gradually revealing the deep pelvis.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「右侧，血肿边界在这里。先别牵拉那一层。」
en: “On the right. The hematoma ends here. Don't pull on that layer yet.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「看到了。吸引，再把视野稍微抬高。」
en: “I see it. Suction, and raise the field a little.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香调整牵开器，避开明显充血的组织。薗田愛実将止血器械递到坂口手边。
en: Serika adjusted the retractor, avoiding visibly congested tissue. Itsumi Sonoda passed a hemostatic instrument into Sakaguchi's hand.

speaker: 薗田愛実
text: 「止血钳。吸引器就在您右手边。」
en: “Hemostat. Suction is beside your right hand.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「裂伤从阴道深部延伸到宫颈侧方，子宫下段外侧也有损伤。旁边的血管分支破了，血一直往深处渗。」
en: “The tear runs from deep in the vagina to the side of the cervix. The outer part of the lower uterine segment is injured too. An adjacent vascular branch is torn, and blood keeps seeping deeper.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「所以外面压住了，里面还是出血。」
en: “So even with external pressure, she's still bleeding inside.”

speaker: 折川皐月
text: 「输血还在继续。血压勉强撑住了，但不能再拖太久。」
en: “The transfusion is continuing. Her blood pressure is barely holding, but we can't wait much longer.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「先控制主要出血点。」
en: “Control the main bleeding point first.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口夹住正在出血的血管分支，芹香在旁稳定组织。吸引器移开后，伤口深处终于能清楚看见。
en: Sakaguchi clamped the bleeding vascular branch while Serika stabilized the tissue beside it. When suction moved away, they could finally see clearly into the wound.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「子宫体本身还有血供。问题集中在下段和侧方损伤。」
en: “The uterine body still has a blood supply. The damage is concentrated in the lower segment and to the side.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「宫颈和阴道深部也需要分层修补。不能只缝住外面看得到的那一截。」
en: “The cervix and deep vaginal injury need layered repair too. We can't just close the part visible from outside.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「嗯。里面的伤口必须一起处理。」
en: “Yes. The internal wound has to be addressed as well.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口尝试处理较深处的出血点，组织却十分脆弱，刚刚获得的视野又被渗出的血遮住。
en: Sakaguchi attempted to treat a deeper bleeding point, but the tissue was extremely fragile. Seeping blood obscured the view they had just gained.

speaker: 折川皐月
text: 「血压又下去了。」
en: “Her blood pressure is dropping again.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「继续输血。御園医生，帮我稳住这里。」
en: “Continue transfusion. Dr. Misono, help me hold this steady.”

speaker: 米田栞
text: 「追加血袋已经核对，正在接上。输血量我会持续记录。」
en: “The additional blood unit has been checked and is being connected. I'll keep recording the transfused volume.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “All right.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香的动作又快又准。她没有去碰坂口正在处理的止血点，只把旁边会妨碍视野的组织轻轻让开。
en: Serika moved swiftly and precisely. She left the bleeding point Sakaguchi was treating untouched, gently moving aside only the adjacent tissue that obstructed his view.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「这条裂口比术前判断的还深。」
en: “This tear is deeper than we thought before surgery.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「如果两侧继续出血，子宫下段的修复也会越来越困难。」
en: “If both sides keep bleeding, repairing the lower uterine segment will get increasingly difficult.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口看了眼监测屏，又看向尚未止住的出血处。
en: Sakaguchi glanced at the monitor, then back at the bleeding that had yet to stop.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「如果局部止血和修补都失败，就得准备切除子宫。这是最后的保命方案。」
en: “If local hemostasis and repair both fail, we'll have to prepare for a hysterectomy. That's the last option to save her life.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香握着牵开器的手微微一紧。
en: Serika's grip on the retractor tightened slightly.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……请等一下。」
en: “…Please wait.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你有别的判断？」
en: “Do you see another option?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「有。这里的组织并没有全部坏死。侧方的出血点能分开处理，子宫下段的裂伤也还有缝合的边缘。」
en: “Yes. The tissue here isn't all necrotic. We can address the lateral bleeding points separately, and there are still edges we can suture in the lower uterine tear.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「可现在的视野很窄。再往外侧，输尿管也必须避开。」
en: “But the field is very narrow. Further laterally, we also have to avoid the ureter.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我知道。我想先沿着完整的组织层次分离，确认输尿管和血管的位置，再尝试修复。」
en: “I know. I'd like to dissect along the intact tissue planes first, identify the ureter and vessels, and then attempt repair.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口没有立即答复。他重新检查组织的颜色和渗血范围。
en: Sakaguchi did not reply immediately. He reassessed the tissue color and the extent of the oozing.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「能做到吗？」
en: “Can it be done?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……有机会。至少，从现在看到的情况，还不到非切不可的程度。」
en: “…There's a chance. At least from what we can see now, removal isn't our only option yet.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「她的生命放在第一位。出血控制不住，就不能继续冒险。」
en: “Her life comes first. If we can't control the bleeding, we can't keep taking risks.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我明白。如果止不住，我不会反对你改用切除方案。」
en: “I understand. If it won't stop, I won't oppose switching to a hysterectomy.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香看了一眼铺巾另一端的患者头部。奈奈美仍然沉睡着，听不见任何讨论。
en: Serika glanced at the patient's head beyond the drapes. Nanami remained asleep, unable to hear their discussion.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「但她还活着。能留下来的东西……我想尽量替她留下来。」
en: “But she's still alive. Whatever we can preserve… I want to preserve as much as we can for her.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口仔细看着裂口两端尚存的完整组织，又抬头看了芹香一眼。
en: Sakaguchi examined the intact tissue remaining at both ends of the tear, then looked up at Serika.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「先找到安全层次和主要出血点，再逐层修补深部裂伤。子宫下段这里，我可以帮你处理。」
en: “Find a safe plane and the main bleeding points first, then repair the deep tear layer by layer. I can help with this part of the lower uterus.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。御園医生，按你说的路线试。一步一步来。任何时候我觉得风险太高，就立即停。」
en: “All right. Dr. Misono, let's try your approach. One step at a time. If I think the risk is too high at any point, we stop immediately.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「明白。」
en: “Understood.”

speaker: 薗田愛実
text: 「细镊、持针器和细线都备好了。需要时直接说。」
en: “Fine forceps, a needle holder, and fine sutures are ready. Just say when you need them.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香换了更细的器械。她放慢速度，先辨认完整的组织边界，再轻轻分开紧贴在一起的两层。
en: Serika switched to finer instruments. Slowing down, she first identified the intact tissue boundary, then gently separated the two closely apposed layers.

speaker: 岩崎留美
text: 「备用的同规格器械也摆好了，纱布已经补齐。」
en: “Spare instruments of the same specifications are laid out too, and the gauze has been replenished.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「镊子。」
en: “Forceps.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 器械递到芹香掌心。她的手没有颤抖，视线始终停在术野上。
en: The instrument was placed in Serika's palm. Her hand did not tremble, and her eyes never left the operative field.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「这里。血管分支从这边进来，不是刚才以为的那条。」
en: “Here. The vascular branch comes in from this side. It isn't the one we thought earlier.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「看到了。我来结扎出血点。你保持视野。」
en: “I see it. I'll ligate the bleeding point. Keep the field open.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口完成关键止血。吸引器再次移开时，手术区域不再立刻被新鲜出血遮满。
en: Sakaguchi secured the critical bleeding point. When suction moved away again, fresh blood no longer immediately flooded the surgical field.

speaker: 米田栞
text: 「下一袋输血已经接上，用血量和出入量都在记录。」
en: “The next blood unit is connected. Blood usage and fluid balance are being recorded.”

speaker: 折川皐月
text: 「血还需要继续补，但血压开始回升了。」
en: “She still needs more blood, but her pressure is starting to rise.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「深部裂口已经能看清了。继续修补。」
en: “We can see the deep tear clearly now. Continue the repair.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口先处理宫颈与阴道深部的损伤；芹香协助牵引和辨认边界，随后在坂口确认下修复子宫下段的裂伤。愛実负责主要的精细器械交接，留美在旁辅助清点、补充器械。
en: Sakaguchi first treated the cervical and deep vaginal injuries. Serika assisted with retraction and identifying the boundaries, then repaired the lower uterine tear with Sakaguchi's confirmation. Itsumi handled the primary fine-instrument exchanges while Rumi assisted with counts and replenishing instruments.

speaker: 岩崎留美
text: 「下一组缝线准备好了。清点记录我在跟。」
en: “The next set of sutures is ready. I'm keeping track of the count.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「这里再补一针。不要拉得太紧。」
en: “One more stitch here. Don't pull too tightly.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「好。让边缘自然贴合。」
en: “Right. Let the edges come together naturally.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香打好结，松开持针器。坂口检查修补处的张力，又观察周围组织的血供。
en: Serika tied the knot and released the needle holder. Sakaguchi checked the tension at the repair and assessed the surrounding tissue's blood supply.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生，怎么看？」
en: “Dr. Misono, what do you think?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「目前没有新的活动性出血。子宫和周围组织的血供也保住了。」
en: “No new active bleeding at present. The blood supply to the uterus and surrounding tissue has been preserved.”

speaker: 折川皐月
text: 「生命体征比刚才稳定了。继续观察没问题。」
en: “Her vital signs are more stable now. We can continue monitoring.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口和芹香再检查一遍盆腔、修补处、膀胱及邻近组织，确认没有遗漏的出血点或明显伴随损伤。
en: Sakaguchi and Serika checked the pelvis, repaired areas, bladder, and adjacent structures once more, confirming no overlooked bleeding points or obvious associated injuries.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。可以结束了。」
en: “Good. We can finish.”

speaker: 薗田愛実
text: 「进入最后清点。缝针和器械我来核对。」
en: “Starting the final count. I'll verify the needles and instruments.”

speaker: 米田栞
text: 「和巡回记录一致。纱布、缝针、器械数量都对。」
en: “They match the circulating record. Gauze, needles, and instruments all accounted for.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 关闭切口、完成器械清点之后，手术终于结束。奈奈美被送往监护病房继续观察。
en: After closing the incision and completing the instrument count, the operation was finally over. Nanami was taken to a monitored ward for continued observation.

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香站在原地，低头看着刚摘下来的手套。她伸手想把手套放进废物桶，却一次没有拿稳。
en: Serika stood still, looking down at the gloves she had just removed. She reached to drop them into the waste bin, but fumbled them on the first try.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生？」
en: “Dr. Misono?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香靠住身后的墙，膝盖微微弯了一下。坂口立刻上前扶住她。
en: Serika leaned against the wall behind her, her knees buckling slightly. Sakaguchi immediately stepped forward to support her.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…I'm sorry.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「不用道歉。坐一会儿。」
en: “No need to apologize. Sit down for a while.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我……刚才真的以为……」
en: “I… I really thought, back there…”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她没有说完，只是用力摇头。
en: She did not finish, only shook her head hard.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「奈奈美的出血止住了。她还需要监护，但最危险的这一关过去了。」
en: “Nanami's bleeding has stopped. She still needs monitoring, but she's past the most dangerous part.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香终于垂下头。半晌之后，她发出一个几乎听不见的回答。
en: At last, Serika lowered her head. After a long while, she gave an almost inaudible reply.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Yes.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 天亮的时候，芹香仍坐在监护病房外的长椅上。她手里拿着医院自动售货机的热饮，却没有打开。
en: At daybreak, Serika was still sitting on the bench outside the monitored ward. She held a hot drink from the hospital vending machine without opening it.

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口从病房走出来，手里夹着刚完成的交接记录。
en: Sakaguchi emerged from the ward, carrying the handover notes he had just completed.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「她现在情况稳定，麻醉正在逐渐退。接下来需要监护出血、感染和其他损伤的情况。」
en: “She's stable now, and the anesthetic is gradually wearing off. We need to keep monitoring for bleeding, infection, and other injuries.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Her uterus?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「保住了。修补处暂时没有新的出血，我会继续跟进术后检查。」
en: “Preserved. There's no new bleeding at the repair for now. I'll keep following her postoperative examinations.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香一直握着饮料罐的手松开了些。
en: Serika's grip on the can loosened a little.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Thank you.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我应该谢谢你。没有你那几个判断，手术会更难。」
en: “I should thank you. Without those judgments of yours, the operation would have been harder.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「先别这么说。她还没有醒。」
en: “Don't say that yet. She hasn't woken up.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「嗯。等她清醒了，我们再把具体情况告诉她。」
en: “Right. Once she's fully conscious, we'll explain everything to her.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香低下头，终于把饮料打开。罐口冒出一点热气。
en: Serika lowered her head and finally opened the drink. A little steam rose from the opening.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我得通知一个人。」
en: “I need to notify someone.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “Who?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「朝仓美幸。她也认识奈奈美。」
en: “Miyuki Asakura. She knows Nanami too.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香拿出手机，拨出一个熟悉的号码。电话接通后，她没有立刻说话。
en: Serika took out her phone and dialed a familiar number. When the call connected, she did not speak immediately.

speaker: 朝仓美幸（电话）
text: 「喂？芹香？这么早，有什么事吗？」
en: “Hello? Serika? What's happened this early?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「美幸……我找到奈奈美了。」
en: “Miyuki… I've found Nanami.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸（电话）
en: “…Who?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「堀内奈奈美。昨天深夜被送进来的。」
en: “Nanami Horiuchi. She was brought in late last night.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸（电话）
text: 「……她怎么样？」
en: “…How is she?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「受了很重的伤。我们刚做完手术。」
en: “Seriously injured. We've just finished operating.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 电话那头沉默了好一会儿。
en: The other end of the line fell silent for a long while.

speaker: 朝仓美幸（电话）
text: 「……还活着吗？」
en: “…Is she alive?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「活着。」
en: “She is.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸（电话）
en: “…Thank goodness.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸（电话）
text: 「我今天去看看她。你先休息，别一个人硬撑。」
en: “I'll visit her today. Get some rest first. Don't try to bear it all alone.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…All right.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 挂断电话后，芹香看了坂口一眼。
en: After hanging up, Serika glanced at Sakaguchi.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我刚才……是不是很没用？」
en: “Was I… useless back there?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你做完了一台很困难的手术。」
en: “You finished a very difficult operation.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我是说手术之后。」
en: “I mean afterward.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「手术之后不用再站得那么直。」
en: “You don't have to keep standing so straight once the operation's over.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香望着他，过了几秒才缓缓点头。
en: Serika looked at him, then slowly nodded after a few seconds.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我跟接班的人交代好了。送你回去吧。」
en: “I've handed everything over to the next shift. Let me take you home.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你值了一夜的班。」
en: “You've been on duty all night.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「已经交班了。我们都该休息。」
en: “I've handed over now. We both need rest.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 两人各自换回常服，走出医院。街上已经有上班的人，早餐店的卷帘门也刚刚打开。
en: They each changed back into their everyday clothes and left the hospital. Commuters were already on the streets, and a breakfast shop had just raised its shutters.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…How strange.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「什么？」
en: “What is?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「总觉得才过了一会儿。外面已经是早上了。」
en: “It feels as though hardly any time has passed. But it's already morning outside.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口陪她走到住处门口。芹香从包里找出钥匙，又停了下来。
en: Sakaguchi walked her to her door. Serika found her keys in her bag, then paused.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「今天……谢谢你送我回来。」
en: “Thank you… for walking me home today.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「先睡一觉。奈奈美醒过来，我会告诉你。」
en: “Get some sleep first. I'll tell you when Nanami wakes up.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…All right.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她推开门，走进去之前又回头看了一眼。坂口仍站在原处。
en: She opened the door and glanced back before going inside. Sakaguchi was still standing where she had left him.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「坂口君。」
en: “Sakaguchi-kun.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “Yes?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……你也好好休息。」
en: “…You get some proper rest too.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 门轻轻关上。坂口在外面站了一会儿，才转身离开。
en: The door closed softly. Sakaguchi remained outside for a moment before turning to leave.

speaker: 旁白
text: 隔日上午，坂口来到病房。还没进门，便看见门边停着两个人。
en: The following morning, Sakaguchi came to the ward. Before he reached the door, he saw two people standing beside it.

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香站得很直，手中却没有病历。朝仓美幸站在她身旁，正低声和护士确认探视时间。
en: Serika stood very straight, though she held no chart. Miyuki Asakura stood beside her, quietly confirming visiting hours with a nurse.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「早。你们都来了。」
en: “Morning. You're both here.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「坂口医生。护士说她已经醒了，能说几句话。」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi. The nurse says she's awake and can speak a little.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……我想看看她。」
en: “…I'd like to see her.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「可以。但不要让她太累，有事情我们改天再谈。」
en: “You may. But don't tire her out. Anything else can wait for another day.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 三人走进病房。奈奈美半靠在枕头上，听见脚步声，缓慢转过脸。
en: The three entered the room. Nanami rested partly upright against her pillows. Hearing footsteps, she slowly turned her face.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
en: “…Doctor?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我是昨天凌晨为你做手术的坂口。这里是星见医院。你现在已经安全了。」
en: “I'm Sakaguchi. I operated on you in the early hours yesterday. This is Hoshimi Hospital. You're safe now.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美眨了眨眼，视线越过坂口，停在芹香脸上。
en: Nanami blinked. Her gaze passed Sakaguchi and settled on Serika's face.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
en: “…Dr.… Serika?”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Nanami.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「真的是……你？」
en: “Is it really… you?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「是我。」
en: “It's me.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美的眼眶一下红了。她试着撑起身子，牵动伤口后又停住。
en: Nanami's eyes immediately reddened. She tried to push herself up, then stopped when it pulled at her wound.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「别起来。腹部的切口还需要时间恢复。」
en: “Don't get up. Your abdominal incision needs time to heal.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「对不起……我以为……我再也……」
en: “I'm sorry… I thought… I'd never…”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓走到床边，轻轻调整枕头，让奈奈美能舒服地靠回去。
en: Asakura approached the bed and gently adjusted the pillows so Nanami could rest back comfortably.

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「先不用把话说完。你看，我们都在这儿。」
en: “You don't need to finish that now. Look, we're all here.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……美幸小姐。」
en: “…Miss Miyuki.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「嗯。好久不见。」
en: “Yes. It's been a long time.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你失了很多血，盆腔有严重损伤。我们做了开腹探查、止血和修补，现在生命体征已经稳定。」
en: “You lost a lot of blood and had severe pelvic injuries. We explored your abdomen, stopped the bleeding, and repaired the damage. Your vital signs are stable now.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「我……是不是被切掉了什么？」
en: “Did you… have to remove something?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「没有做子宫切除。我们尽可能把受损部位修复好了，后续还要复查恢复情况。」
en: “We didn't perform a hysterectomy. We repaired the damaged areas as well as we could. We'll keep checking how they heal.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美看了看坂口，又看向芹香，眼泪顺着脸颊流下来。
en: Nanami looked at Sakaguchi, then at Serika. Tears ran down her cheeks.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
en: “…Thank you.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「先把身体养好。」
en: “Focus on getting better.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美闭上眼睛，缓慢呼吸了几次，才重新开口。
en: Nanami closed her eyes and took several slow breaths before speaking again.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
en: “It was… Shiozaki.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香脸上的血色一点点退去。朝仓没有接话。
en: The color slowly drained from Serika's face. Asakura said nothing.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「他一直不让我离开。后来……他弄伤了我。我记得自己晕过去之前，还在求他停下。」
en: “He wouldn't let me leave. Then… he hurt me. I remember begging him to stop before I passed out.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「再醒来……就是这里了。我不知道他把我扔到了哪里。」
en: “When I woke up again… I was here. I don't know where he left me.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你不用现在详细回忆。我们已经处理了伤，也会把医疗记录妥善保存。」
en: “You don't need to remember the details now. We've treated your injuries, and we'll keep the medical records safe.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「还有亚矢、弥生、惠理……」
en: “And Aya, Yayoi, Eri…”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「她们怎么了？」
en: “What happened to them?”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「还在那里。他不让她们走，逼她们做不愿意做的事……我出来以前，她们一个都没能离开。」
en: “They're still there. He won't let them go. He forces them to do things they don't want to… Before I got out, none of them had been able to leave.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香的手贴在病床边缘，没有碰到奈奈美身上的管线。
en: Serika rested her hand on the edge of the bed, avoiding Nanami's lines.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……她们还活着？」
en: “…Are they still alive?”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「我离开的时候……都还活着。」
en: “When I left… they were all alive.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香抬起另一只手，遮住自己的眼睛。
en: Serika raised her other hand to cover her eyes.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「奈奈美小姐，你可以决定什么时候、向谁讲述这些。现在最重要的是休息和继续治疗。」
en: “Miss Nanami, you can decide when to tell this, and to whom. For now, rest and continued treatment matter most.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……我想报警。」
en: “…I want to call the police.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。我现在就请值班负责人联系警方。你的经历不需要今天全部讲完，但那三个人可能还在危险中，我们不能等。」
en: “All right. I'll ask the duty supervisor to contact them now. You don't have to recount everything today, but those three may still be in danger. We can't wait.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……请先救她们。」
en: “…Please save them first.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「旧院的地址和内部情况，我都知道。需要的话，我可以提供。」
en: “I know the old hospital's address and layout. I can provide them if needed.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「我去联系值班负责人。先把这件事正式报上去。」
en: “I'll contact the duty supervisor. Let's get this formally reported first.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美点点头。朝仓把床边的纸巾拿过来，放到她够得到的地方。
en: Nanami nodded. Asakura brought the tissues from beside the bed and placed them within her reach.

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「那我们先出去一会儿。想见我们时，让护士来叫就好。」
en: “We'll step outside for a while, then. If you want to see us, just ask a nurse to call us.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……别走太远，好吗？」
en: “…Don't go too far, all right?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我还在医院里。」
en: “I'll still be in the hospital.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美看了她一会儿，终于松开一直攥紧的被角。
en: Nanami watched her for a moment, then finally released the blanket corner she had been gripping.

speaker: 旁白
text: 离开病房后，朝仓立即联系院内值班负责人，请对方联络警方。她说明奈奈美主动要求报警，也报上了另外三名可能仍受困护士的姓名与旧院地址。
en: After leaving the room, Asakura immediately contacted the hospital's duty supervisor and asked them to reach the police. She explained that Nanami had asked to report the crime, and supplied the names of the three other nurses who might still be trapped, along with the old hospital's address.

speaker: 旁白
text: 下午，芹香和朝仓再次来到病房。奈奈美没有睡，正看着窗边的光。
en: That afternoon, Serika and Asakura returned to the room. Nanami was awake, watching the light by the window.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……我刚才一直在想，有一件事，不能再不说了。」
en: “…I've been thinking. There's something I can't keep leaving unsaid.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「如果累了，可以下次再说。」
en: “If you're tired, you can tell us next time.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「不是病的事。」
en: “It isn't about my condition.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美转向她，眼里重新涌出泪水。
en: Nanami turned toward her, tears welling up again.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「芹香医生……以前在医院里，我做过的那些事……」
en: “Dr. Serika… The things I did back at the hospital…”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「我明明知道你也很痛苦，却还是站在他那边。我一直欠你一句道歉。」
en: “I knew how much you were suffering, but I still took his side. I've owed you an apology all this time.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……我没有忘记。」
en: “…I haven't forgotten.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「我知道。我也不敢叫你忘记。」
en: “I know. I wouldn't dare ask you to.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「对不起。真的……对不起。」
en: “I'm sorry. I'm truly… sorry.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香垂下眼睛，过了很久才抬起头。
en: Serika lowered her eyes. A long time passed before she looked up.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……那时候，我也有很多事不敢面对。」
en: “…Back then, there was a lot I didn't dare face either.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「可这不代表你当时做的事情就没有发生过。」
en: “But that doesn't mean the things you did never happened.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
en: “…I know.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 奈奈美伸出手。芹香迟疑一下，还是轻轻握住了。
en: Nanami reached out. Serika hesitated, then gently took her hand.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「谢谢你……还愿意救我。」
en: “Thank you… for still being willing to save me.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你是病人。我在手术台边，做了应该做的事。」
en: “You're a patient. At the operating table, I did what I should.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她的声音仍然平静，握着奈奈美的手却没有立刻松开。
en: Her voice remained calm, but she did not immediately let go of Nanami's hand.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……还有一件事。我知道自己现在说这个很任性。」
en: “…There's one more thing. I know it's selfish to say this now.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「什么事？」
en: “What is it?”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「你能不能回去一趟？去见见你父亲。」
en: “Could you go back once? To see your father.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香的手明显停了一下。
en: Serika's hand visibly stilled.

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「那家医院原本应该是你的。你会做手术，也会照顾人。那里需要能真正做决定的人。」
en: “That hospital was supposed to be yours. You can operate, and you care for people. It needs someone who can truly make decisions.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Nanami.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「我不是要你现在回去替我们收拾残局。只是……我以前总觉得，等你回来，一切就会不一样。」
en: “I'm not asking you to go back and clean up our mess now. It's just… I used to think everything would be different once you returned.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓往前走了一步，在奈奈美能看见的位置停下。
en: Asakura took a step forward, stopping where Nanami could see her.

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「奈奈美。先到这里吧。」
en: “Nanami. Let's leave it there for now.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……美幸小姐？」
en: “…Miss Miyuki?”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「你想让芹香听见的话，她已经听见了。但有些事情，不需要今天就得到答案。」
en: “Serika has heard what you wanted her to hear. But some things don't need an answer today.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……对不起。我又太着急了。」
en: “…I'm sorry. I'm rushing things again.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我会考虑。现在先不要想这个。」
en: “I'll think about it. For now, put it out of your mind.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
en: “…All right.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓替奈奈美把被角抚平。芹香缓慢松开她的手，站起身来。
en: Asakura smoothed Nanami's blanket. Serika slowly released her hand and stood up.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「有事就按铃。护士会来，我也会来看你。」
en: “Press the bell if you need anything. A nurse will come, and I'll visit too.”

speaker: 堀内奈奈美
text: 「……谢谢你，芹香医生。」
en: “…Thank you, Dr. Serika.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 走出病房后，朝仓和芹香在自动门旁停下。玻璃上映出两人穿着白色工作服的身影。
en: Outside the room, Asakura and Serika stopped beside the automatic doors. The glass reflected their figures in white work clothes.

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Thank you.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「我又没做什么。只是帮她把话停下来。」
en: “I didn't do anything. Just helped her stop talking.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「不是只有今天。」
en: “I don't only mean today.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓看向她。这一次，她没有立即开玩笑。
en: Asakura looked at her. This time, she did not immediately make a joke.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「以前也是你……最后把我带走的。」
en: “Back then, too… you were the one who finally got me out.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
en: “…Serika.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「可我有时候又会想起，最开始你对我做过的那些事。我知道自己很矛盾。」
en: “But sometimes I remember the things you did to me at the beginning. I know I'm conflicted.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「那就矛盾着吧。」
en: “Then be conflicted.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…What?”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「我确实做过不该做的事。后来带你走，也不是为了让你必须感谢我。」
en: “I did things I shouldn't have. Getting you out afterward wasn't meant to make you owe me gratitude.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「我们现在都在星见。总有一天可以好好谈。但不用在今天把所有事情说完。」
en: “We're both at Hoshimi now. Someday we can talk properly. But we don't have to say everything today.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香望向走廊尽头，好一会儿没有出声。
en: Serika looked toward the end of the corridor and remained silent for a long while.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……嗯。今天先这样。」
en: “…All right. Let's leave it here today.”

speaker: 朝仓美幸
text: 「我也正是这个意思。」
en: “That's exactly what I mean.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓朝她笑了一下，转身去护士站。芹香站在原地，直到病房门在身后重新关好。
en: Asakura gave her a small smile and turned toward the nurses' station. Serika stayed where she was until the ward doors had closed behind her again.

speaker: 旁白
text: 晚上，坂口整理完最后一份病历，准备离开医院。走到出口附近时，他看见芹香站在灯下。
en: That evening, Sakaguchi finished the last chart and prepared to leave the hospital. Near the exit, he saw Serika standing beneath a light.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「御園医生？还没回去？」
en: “Dr. Misono? You haven't gone home?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……我在等你。」
en: “…I was waiting for you.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「等我？」
en: “For me?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香把包的肩带往上拉了一点，目光却没有立刻看向他。
en: Serika pulled her bag strap a little higher on her shoulder, but did not immediately look at him.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你现在下班吗？」
en: “Are you leaving work now?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「嗯。今天没有别的安排了。」
en: “Yes. I have no other plans today.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「那……能不能陪我一起下班？」
en: “Then… could we leave together?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「当然。你想去哪儿？」
en: “Of course. Where would you like to go?”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…My place.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她终于抬眼看向坂口。
en: At last, she raised her eyes to Sakaguchi.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我今天不太想一个人待着。」
en: “I don't really want to be alone today.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「好。我陪你。」
en: “All right. I'll stay with you.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 两人走出医院。夜间的街道格外安静，路边商店的灯已经陆续熄灭。
en: They left the hospital. The nighttime streets were especially quiet, and the lights in the roadside shops were going out one after another.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「今天下午，你和朝仓小姐谈过了？」
en: “Did you talk with Miss Asakura this afternoon?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……谈了一点。」
en: “…A little.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「怎么样？」
en: “How did it go?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「没有吵架，也没有抱在一起说过去都算了。」
en: “We didn't argue. We didn't hug and say the past was all forgiven either.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「听起来已经不错了。」
en: “That already sounds pretty good.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「她也是这么说的。你们有时候还挺像。」
en: “She said that too. Sometimes you're rather alike.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香说完这句，自己也笑不出来，只把外套的领口拢紧了一些。
en: After saying it, Serika could not bring herself to smile. She only pulled her coat collar a little closer.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……奈奈美睡着之后，我一直在想她刚才说的话。」
en: “…After Nanami fell asleep, I kept thinking about what she'd said.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “Yes.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我不知道那几个人以后会怎么样。也不知道自己应不应该回去。」
en: “I don't know what will happen to those people. And I don't know whether I should go back.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你不用今晚就决定。」
en: “You don't have to decide tonight.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…I know.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香打开家门，先把鞋整齐放到一边。坂口跟着进来，顺手将门轻轻关好。
en: Serika opened her door and neatly placed her shoes to one side. Sakaguchi followed her inside, gently closing the door behind him.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你先坐。我去倒水。」
en: “Have a seat. I'll get some water.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我来吧。你想喝什么？」
en: “Let me. What would you like?”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Anything.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她站在客厅中央，像是突然忘记自己刚刚要做什么。
en: She stood in the middle of the living room, as though she had suddenly forgotten what she was about to do.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「……御園医生。你要不要先坐一下？」
en: “…Dr. Misono. Would you like to sit down first?”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…Yes.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香坐到沙发一侧。坂口把倒好的水放在她面前，在另一侧坐下。
en: Serika sat at one end of the sofa. Sakaguchi placed a glass of water before her and sat at the other end.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……我以为自己已经不会那么害怕了。」
en: “…I thought I wasn't that frightened anymore.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「今天发生的事太多了。」
en: “A lot happened today.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「不是今天才开始的。」
en: “It didn't start today.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她盯着杯沿，呼吸逐渐变得急促。眼泪一滴一滴落到握紧的手背上。
en: She stared at the rim of the glass, her breathing growing faster. Tears fell one by one onto the backs of her clenched hands.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我明明已经离开那家医院，重新开始工作了……」
en: “I've already left that hospital and started working again…”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「可只要一听见他的名字，我还是会想起那些事。」
en: “But whenever I hear his name, I still remember those things.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香终于抬起头。她努力让声音保持平稳，却在开口时哽住了。
en: At last, Serika looked up. She tried to keep her voice steady, but choked as she began to speak.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……我讨厌这样。」
en: “…I hate this.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “…Yes.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我在手术室里还可以拿起器械，还能告诉你哪里能缝、哪里不能碰。」
en: “In the operating room, I can still pick up instruments. I can still tell you where to suture and where not to touch.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「可是手术一结束，我连站都站不稳。」
en: “But once the operation is over, I can't even stand steadily.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她低下头，手指紧紧抓住自己的衣角。
en: She lowered her head, her fingers gripping the hem of her clothes.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我要知道……我没有被那个男人毁掉。」
en: “I need to know… that man hasn't destroyed me.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你没有必要用今晚向谁证明这件事。」
en: “You don't need to prove that to anyone tonight.”

speaker: 坂口隆司

en: “Not long ago. Last night… I slept very well.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她把一杯咖啡递给坂口，自己捧着另一杯在桌边坐下。
en: She handed Sakaguchi a cup of coffee and sat at the table with her own.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「身体还好吗？」
en: “How are you feeling physically?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……你是医生的职业病又犯了吗？」
en: “…Is that your doctor's occupational habit again?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「只是问问。」
en: “Just asking.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我很好。只是眼睛有点肿。」
en: “I'm fine. My eyes are a little swollen, that's all.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她摸了摸眼角，抬起脸看向坂口。
en: She touched the corner of her eye, then lifted her face toward Sakaguchi.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……昨天，让你看见了很难看的样子。」
en: “…Yesterday, you saw me in a dreadful state.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「我不觉得难看。」
en: “I didn't think it was dreadful.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香低头喝了一口咖啡，停了片刻。
en: Serika lowered her head, took a sip of coffee, and paused.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「奈奈美让我回去见父亲。你也听见了。」
en: “Nanami asked me to go back and see my father. You heard her too.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「听见了。你想好了吗？」
en: “I did. Have you decided?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「还没有。我不想在这种时候，立刻做决定。」
en: “Not yet. I don't want to make an immediate decision at a time like this.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「那家医院、父亲，还有美幸……我欠着自己很多话要说。」
en: “That hospital, my father, and Miyuki… There are so many things I still owe it to myself to say.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「你可以慢慢来。」
en: “You can take your time.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……但有一件事，我想清楚了。」
en: “…But there's one thing I've made up my mind about.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她放下咖啡，坐得比刚才直了一些。
en: She set down her coffee and sat a little straighter.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「潮崎做过的事，我不会再当作没看见。」
en: “I won't pretend I haven't seen what Shiozaki has done anymore.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「奈奈美已经请医院联系警方。我也会去作证，把我知道的事情说出来。」
en: “Nanami has asked the hospital to contact the police. I'll testify too, and tell them what I know.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “Yes.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「还有……潮崎曾逼我给父亲下毒。我没有真的做，可我那时候差一点就听了他的话。是美幸把我带离了那里。」
en: “And… Shiozaki once forced me to poison my father. I didn't actually do it, but I nearly obeyed him then. Miyuki was the one who took me away.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「……谢谢你愿意告诉我。」
en: “…Thank you for being willing to tell me.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……我一直很害怕。怕自己有一天真的会变成那种人。」
en: “…I've always been afraid. Afraid I might really become that kind of person one day.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「可如果又逃走一次，我以后连自己都不敢相信了。」
en: “But if I run away again, I won't even be able to trust myself afterward.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口坐在她对面，等她继续说下去。
en: Sakaguchi sat across from her, waiting for her to continue.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我暂时还是想留在星见。这里……现在是我自己选择的地方。」
en: “For now, I still want to stay at Hoshimi. This place… is somewhere I've chosen for myself now.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「那就留下来。等你想清楚下一步再说。」
en: “Then stay. You can decide the next step when you're ready.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香轻轻点头。她的视线从窗边移回来，重新停在坂口脸上。
en: Serika nodded gently. Her gaze left the window and settled on Sakaguchi's face again.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……还有一件事。」
en: “…There's something else.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
en: “Yes?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「昨晚的事情……我不想让你以为，那只是因为我害怕一个人。」
en: “About last night… I don't want you to think it was only because I was afraid to be alone.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我喜欢你。以前就开始喜欢了，只是一直不敢说。」
en: “I like you. I started liking you some time ago. I just never dared say it.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「芹香……我也喜欢你。」
en: “Serika… I like you too.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香低下头，耳朵微微红了。她用指尖碰了一下杯柄，又抬起眼睛。
en: Serika lowered her head, her ears turning slightly red. She touched the cup handle with a fingertip, then raised her eyes again.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「那我们……现在算恋人了吗？」
en: “Then… are we a couple now?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「如果你愿意。」
en: “If you want to be.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……你连这种事都要等我正式确认吗？」
en: “…Do you even need my formal confirmation for something like this?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「在医院学到的。重要的事情，得由当事人自己决定。」
en: “I learned it at the hospital. Important things have to be decided by the person concerned.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 芹香先是怔住，随后轻轻笑出了声。
en: Serika paused, then laughed softly.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「……真是个奇怪的医生。」
en: “…What a strange doctor.”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「我愿意。坂口君。」
en: “I do. Sakaguchi-kun.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「那么，以后在医院外面，我可以叫你芹香吗？」
en: “Then may I call you Serika outside the hospital from now on?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你昨晚不是已经叫过了吗？」
en: “Didn't you already call me that last night?”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「那时候没来得及问。」
en: “I didn't get a chance to ask then.”

speaker: 御園芹香
en: “…You may.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她向坂口伸出手。坂口握住之后，她却没有立即松开。
en: She held her hand out to Sakaguchi. Once he took it, she did not immediately let go.

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「不过，既然是男朋友了……还有一件事。」
en: “But now that you're my boyfriend… there's one more thing.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「什么？」
en: “What?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「你欠我的贝斯功课，还没交。」
en: “You still haven't turned in the bass homework you owe me.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「……现在要考试？」
en: “…Are we having a test now?”

speaker: 御園芹香
text: 「不用。可以慢慢来。」
en: “No need. You can take your time.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她朝坂口微微一笑，伸手把两个人的空杯子收进水槽。窗外的早晨已经彻底亮了。
en: She gave Sakaguchi a small smile and carried their empty cups to the sink. Outside the window, morning had fully arrived.

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口帮她拿起桌边的外套。两人一起整理好东西，准备回到医院各自的岗位。
en: Sakaguchi helped her pick up the coat beside the table. Together they gathered their things, ready to return to their respective posts at the hospital.
